bullets.title: Why I Am a Bad Correspondent
bullets.creator: Neal Stephenson
bullets.note: fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9h9609x/mwf7h5hqn7e2w5/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9uZWFsc3RlcGhlbnNvbg==)), one of my favorite sci-fi writers. This short, anti-comms blog post contains gems like this: “The quality of my e-mails and public speaking is, in my view, nowhere near that of my novels. So for me it comes down to the following choice: I can distribute material of bad-to-mediocre quality to a small number of people, or I can distribute material of higher quality to more people. But I can’t do both; the first one obliterates the second.”

bullets.title: Bertrand Russell
bullets.note: , the British philosopher, logician, mathematician, historian, writer, essayist, social critic, political activist, and Nobel laureate. In 1950, Russell was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature “in recognition of his varied and significant writings in which he champions humanitarian ideals and freedom of thought.”

bullets.title: To Live and Die in LA
bullets.note: Official description: “In Feb 2018, an aspiring actress vanished from her Hollywood apartment. _Rolling Stone_ journalist [Neil Strauss](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9h9609x/pmseh9h27lxr8w/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE0LzA2LzI0L25laWwtc3RyYXVzcy8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NWJm) was asked to help the family get answers. Together, they found them...sometimes at great personal risk. For the first time in a serial podcast, go inside a gripping multi-state investigation as it unfolds from the moment of the disappearance to each twist and turn in the case.”

bullets.title: Fountain Pen Hospital
bullets.note: “Fountain Pen Hospital was founded in 1946 by Phil Wiederlight and Al Wiederlight (the father and grandfather, respectively, of today's proprietors – Terry and Steve Wiederlight). Terry and Steve have a combined 60 years experience in all phases of vintage and modern writing instruments.” Special thanks to [Neil Gaiman](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9h9609x/59bvh7hn9z73l6/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzAzLzI4L25laWwtZ2FpbWFuLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=) for recommending it during [our interview together](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9h9609x/22h2hoh8oedlnm/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE5LzAzLzI4L25laWwtZ2FpbWFuLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=), in which he described how and why he does so much writing by hand.
